speech.heard: Nigeria applies 13 kg of fertilizer per hectare of arable land. The USA applies 128 kg per hectare, while India uses 214. Climbing higher, Brazil uses 397 kg, Egypt has 598, Ireland 987, and Malaysia 1,869. At the top, Kuwait uses 2,488 kg per hectare, 19 times what the USA uses. This counts nitrogenous, potash and phosphate plant nutrients used per unit of arable land. How heavily fertilized is the cropland in your country?
